review_scope: Independent packet-only semantic review; current PDF text, official source, Blueprint, R08 findings and register reconciliation; no visual inspection or binary SHA recomputation
criterion_verdicts: 1. Official I18-E02 wording, DOCX 0095, analysis-report genre, case mapping, title-blind identifiability, separation from 0094/I18-E01 and 0096/I18-E03=PASS
2. All Unique Blueprint sections, required tables/figure/analysis, questions, calculations, direct usability and acceptance tests=PASS

3. Reassessment of the five R08 findings (R08-01 page-map precision; R08-02 uncounted CUSTOMER_VALID_RETURN_SHARE; R08-03 sample class wording; R08-04 review receipt status; R08-05 small-sample sensitivity)=PARTIAL

4. Recomputation of all learner/customer raw counts, sums, means, positive counts/rates, rankings, gaps, single-record sensitivity, outcome figures, denominators, missing/N/A rules, rounding and suppression; no merging of distinct respondent populations=PASS

5. Direct administration of both tools: eligibility, consent, scale, N/A, incomplete/withdrawn/invalid/valid status, REAL blank dates, invitation/delivery/return, population boundary, privacy/storage, aggregation and hold/reject criteria; proposed controls distinct from implemented operation=PASS

6. SAMPLE/SYNTHETIC vs REAL boundaries and replacement-register traceability; no fabricated people, approvals, signatures, courses, respondents, survey execution, outcomes or third-party records; missing REAL items remain UNKNOWN with safe source paths=PASS

7. Usability for a small volunteer association: SOP, data dictionary, worked case, ranked recommendations, decision criteria, responsibility/deadline/metric fields and follow-up; recommendations separate from authorization/execution=PASS
8. Negative-neighbour and title-blind tests reject at least two wrong documents by concrete body-level fields/sections=PASS

9. §1.4 page locators against the current 43-page R09 export; no nonexistent subsection cited; §4.1/§4.2/§4.3 page spans cover their actual sections; §7.3–§7.4 point to their actual page; register page locators remain correct; R09 appendices/version lineage and exact R06/R07/R08 history preserved without rewriting prior artefacts=PARTIAL
10. Remaining material contradiction, unsupported claim, ambiguous field, unusable form, arithmetic mismatch, overclaim, required omission or traceability defect=PARTIAL
limitations: Packet-only review: no shell, filesystem, browser, GUI or other tooling was used or attempted; no DOCX binary rehash, no PDF re-render, no DOCX XML extraction, and no font-size or layout measurement.

No visual inspection of the 43-page export was performed; every page, table, row, cell and heading reference above is read from the packet's page-bounded PDF text. Image presence or absence (including whether 附圖 A exists as a drawn object) and typography could not be confirmed.
All arithmetic was recomputed by hand from the raw response rows printed in §6.1, §6.2 and §6.4 and from the CSV body reproduced in the packet; no spreadsheet or calculation engine was used.

SHA-256 values (DOCX, PDF, CSV, manifest, official sources, Blueprint row) were compared for internal consistency only and were not independently recomputed; the reviewed DOCX SHA is bound exactly as supplied by the packet.
Findings are bound to the DOCX SHA-256 e1be4a9e…0ed8e as supplied. Any re-export, re-layout or content change invalidates this verdict and requires a new exact-SHA review.

This is a semantic review of the supplied candidate only. It is not a TTQS assessment, not a score, not an evaluation of the association's real practice, and not formal association acceptance. The deliverable remains CANDIDATE.

R08's five findings were reassessed independently from the current R09 evidence and the deterministic R06/R08 key-set reconciliation; where the reconciliation contradicts an allegation (R08-02), the allegation was not repeated, and no prior artefact was rewritten in the process.
